_about: The brand plate at the very top of every page. Content, so it lives
here rather than in markup — invariant 2 — and a destination is a
real href in the app, checked against navigation.json by hand when
you add one. A plate pointing at a module that does not exist is
IT DOES NOT ROTATE ON A TIMER, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. The verify
gate captures each page's visible words and fails a later run for
words that have gone missing; text that changes by itself is a
clock, and CLAUDE.md records what a clock costs — a baseline taken
on 29 September failed on the 30th over festival countdowns. A
timed carousel would have put three messages into rotation and only
one of them into the baseline. So index 0 is what every load shows
and the dots advance it only when somebody clicks.
